title: Animations, Transitions, and Slide Show Delivery
description: Apply transitions and animations, practice slide show delivery, use Presenter View, and print handouts
objective: Students will apply transitions between slides, add entrance, emphasis, and exit animations to objects, use the Animation Pane, run a slide show with keyboard shortcuts, and print handouts.

steps.title: Apply Transitions Between Slides
steps.instructions:
1. Open the **MyCity_YourName.pptx** presentation from Lab 08A
   (If you don't have it, create a quick 4-slide presentation with title, content, SmartArt, and thank you slides)

2. **Apply individual transitions:**
   - Click on **Slide 1** in the Slide Panel
   - Go to the **Transitions** tab in the Ribbon
   - Click **Fade** — watch the preview animation
   - Click on **Slide 2** → apply **Push** transition
   - Click the **Effect Options** button → select **From Right**
   - Click on **Slide 3** → apply **Wipe** transition
   - Click **Effect Options** → select **From Bottom**
   - Click on **Slide 4** → apply **Split** transition

3. **Set transition duration:**
   - Select **Slide 1** → in the **Duration** box (Timing group), change to **01.50** (1.5 seconds)
   - Do the same for all slides

4. **Apply uniform transition (Apply to All):**
   - Select any slide
   - Choose the **Fade** transition
   - Set Duration to **01.00** (1 second)
   - Click the **Apply To All** button
   - Now ALL slides have the same Fade transition

5. **Set automatic timing:**
   - In the **Timing** group, check **After:** and set it to **00:05.00** (5 seconds)
   - Click **Apply To All**
   - Now slides will auto-advance every 5 seconds

6. Press **F5** to preview the transitions in slide show mode. Press **Esc** when done.

**CCC Exam Fact:** Transitions are applied **between slides** (not to objects). The **Apply To All** button sets the same transition for every slide.

steps.title: Add Animations to Objects
steps.instructions:
1. Go to **Slide 2** in Normal View

2. **Add Entrance animation to the title:**
   - Click the **title text box** to select it
   - Go to the **Animations** tab
   - Click **Fly In** from the animation gallery
   - Click **Effect Options** → **From Top**
   - A small **1** appears on the title — this is the animation order number

3. **Add Entrance animation to the content text:**
   - Click the **bullet point text box**
   - Click **Fade** from the animation gallery
   - Click **Effect Options** → **By Paragraph** (text appears one bullet at a time)
   - A small **2** appears on the content

4. **Add Entrance animation to a picture (if you have one):**
   - Click the **picture/image** on the slide
   - Click **Zoom** from the animation gallery
   - A small **3** appears on the picture

5. **Set animation timing:**
   - Click on the title (animation 1) → in the **Timing** group:
     - Start: **On Click**
     - Duration: **00.75** (0.75 seconds)
   - Click on the content text (animation 2) → Timing:
     - Start: **After Previous**
     - Duration: **01.00**
     - Delay: **00.50** (0.5 second pause before starting)
   - Click on the picture (animation 3) → Timing:
     - Start: **After Previous**
     - Duration: **01.00**

6. Click **Preview** (left side of Animations tab) to see all animations play

**CCC Exam Fact:** Animations are applied to **objects within a slide**. The four types are: Entrance (green), Emphasis (yellow), Exit (red), and Motion Path (blue).

steps.title: Use the Animation Pane and Add Multiple Animations
steps.instructions:
1. **Open the Animation Pane:**
   - Go to the **Animations** tab → click **Animation Pane** (in the Advanced Animation group)
   - A panel opens on the right showing all animations for the current slide
   - You should see your three animations listed in order

2. **Reorder animations:**
   - In the Animation Pane, click on an animation item
   - Use the **up/down arrows** (Move Earlier / Move Later) to change the order
   - Try moving the picture animation to play before the text
   - Then move it back to its original position

3. **Add multiple animations to one object:**
   - Go to **Slide 5** (or any slide with SmartArt)
   - Click the **SmartArt** graphic
   - Apply **Fly In** entrance animation
   - Now, instead of clicking on another animation in the gallery (which replaces it), click **Add Animation** button (in Advanced Animation group)
   - Select **Pulse** from the Emphasis section
   - The Animation Pane now shows TWO animations for the SmartArt:
     - 1: Fly In (Entrance — green)
     - 2: Pulse (Emphasis — yellow)
   - Set Pulse to Start: **After Previous**, Delay: **01.00**

4. **Add an Exit animation:**
   - With the SmartArt still selected, click **Add Animation** again
   - Scroll down to the **Exit** section and select **Fade**
   - The Animation Pane now shows THREE animations for the SmartArt
   - Set Exit to Start: **After Previous**, Delay: **02.00**

5. Click **Preview** or press **Shift + F5** to preview from this slide

**CCC Exam Fact:** Use **Add Animation** to add multiple animations to the same object. The Animation Pane shows all animations in order and lets you reorder them.

steps.title: Run Slide Show and Practice Navigation
steps.instructions:
1. **Start from the beginning:**
   - Press **F5** — the slide show starts from **Slide 1**
   - Click or press **Enter** to advance through slides and trigger animations
   - Watch the transitions between slides and animations within slides

2. **Practice navigation shortcuts:**
   - Press **N** or **Enter** or **Space** → next slide
   - Press **P** or **Backspace** → previous slide
   - Press **B** → screen goes black (press **B** again to return)
   - Press **W** → screen goes white (press **W** again to return)
   - Type **3** then press **Enter** → jumps to Slide 3
   - Press **Home** → jumps to first slide
   - Press **End** → jumps to last slide

3. **Use pointer tools:**
   - Press **Ctrl + P** → mouse becomes a **Pen** (draw on the slide)
   - Draw a circle around something on the slide
   - Press **Ctrl + L** → mouse becomes a **Laser pointer** (red dot)
   - Press **Ctrl + A** → mouse returns to normal **Arrow**
   - Press **Ctrl + E** → **Eraser** (erase pen marks)

4. **End the show:**
   - Press **Esc** to end the slide show
   - When asked "Keep or Discard pen annotations?" → click **Discard**

5. **Start from current slide:**
   - Click on **Slide 3** in Normal View
   - Press **Shift + F5** — the show starts from **Slide 3** (not Slide 1)
   - Press **Esc** to exit

**CCC Exam Fact:** **F5** = start from beginning. **Shift + F5** = start from current slide. **Esc** = end show. **B** = black screen. **W** = white screen.

steps.title: Rehearse Timings and Print Handouts
steps.instructions:
1. **Rehearse Timings:**
   - Go to **Slide Show** tab → click **Rehearse Timings**
   - The slide show starts with a **Recording toolbar** in the top-left corner
   - The toolbar shows: current slide time and total time
   - Speak about each slide for 10-15 seconds, then click to advance
   - After the last slide, a dialog asks: **"The total time was XX:XX. Do you want to save the slide timings?"**
   - Click **Yes**
   - Switch to **Slide Sorter View** (View → Slide Sorter) — you'll see the timing below each slide thumbnail (e.g., 00:12, 00:15)

2. **Print as Handouts:**
   - Press **Ctrl + P** (or File → Print)
   - Under **Settings**, click the layout dropdown (it says "Full Page Slides")
   - Select **Handouts** → **3 Slides** per page
   - Look at the **Print Preview** on the right:
     - You should see 3 slide thumbnails on the left side of each page
     - Lines for notes appear on the right side (for students to write)
   - Change the printer to **Microsoft Print to PDF**
   - Click **Print** and save as `MyCity_Handouts3_YourName.pdf`

3. **Print as 6-per-page handout:**
   - Press **Ctrl + P** again
   - Change layout to **Handouts** → **6 Slides** per page
   - Save as PDF: `MyCity_Handouts6_YourName.pdf`

4. **Print Notes Pages:**
   - Press **Ctrl + P** again
   - Change layout to **Notes Pages**
   - This shows one slide per page with speaker notes below
   - Preview it (you don't need to print this one)

5. **Export as PDF:**
   - Go to **File** → **Export** → **Create PDF/XPS Document**
   - Click **Create PDF/XPS**
   - Save as `MyCity_Final_YourName.pdf`

**CCC Exam Fact:** To print **3 slides per page** with lines for notes, select **Handouts (3 Slides)**. This is the most common handout format and is very frequently asked in the CCC exam.
